cards.name: Hour of Glory
cards.text:
6 Chronal Ascension.
Increase Damage Amount of the next Attack Card of this unit used by 10% for each combined Cost of cards activated during this battle (max 200%).

cards.name: Time Acceleration
cards.text: 350% Damage.

cards.name: Rewind
cards.text: Heal 100%.

cards.name: Chrono Archon
cards.text: When a card is activated, 1 Chronicle for each Cost of that card.

cards.name: Chrono Archon I
cards.text:
When a card is activated, 1 Chronicle for each Cost of that card.
When Chronal Ascension is removed, 3 Chronicle.

cards.name: Chrono Archon II
cards.text:
When a card is activated, 1 Chronicle for each Cost of that card.
At the end of the turn, 100% Damage to a random enemy for each Chronal Ascension.

cards.name: Chrono Archon III
cards.text: When a card is Exhausted, 1 Chronicle

cards.name: Chrono Archon IV
cards.text:
When a card is activated, 1 Chronicle for each Cost of that card.
When a card is Discarded, 1 Chronicle.

cards.name: Chrono Archon V
cards.text:
When a card is activated, 1 Chronicle for each Cost of that card.
When a Retain effect is activated, 1 Chronicle.

cards.name: Time Axis Collapse
cards.text:
300% Damage.
Increase Damage Amount by 20% for each combined Cost of cards in hand (max 200%).

cards.name: Time Axis Collapse I
cards.text:
450% Damage.
Increase Damage Amount by 20% for each combined Cost of cards in hand (max 200%).

cards.name: Time Axis Collapse II
cards.text:
300% Damage.
Increase Damage Amount by 30% for each 1-Cost or lower card in hand.

cards.name: Time Axis Collapse III
cards.text: Increase Damage Amount of the next 3 Attack Card(s) of this unit used by 100%.

cards.name: Time Axis Collapse IV
cards.text:
400% Damage.
2 Vulnerable. When Chronal Ascension is gained, activate this card if in hand.

cards.name: Time Axis Collapse V
cards.text:
250% Damage.
Change Cost of all Fate Imprint in hand to 4.

cards.name: Future Decreed
cards.text: Increase Cost of 1 2-Cost or lower card(s) by 1 until used, then activate 1 random 3-Cost card(s).

cards.name: Future Decreed I
cards.text: Increase Cost of 1 2-Cost or lower card(s) by 1 until used, then activate 1 random 3-Cost card(s).

cards.name: Future Decreed II
cards.text: Activate 1 random 3-Cost Attack Card(s) in hand.

cards.name: Future Decreed III
cards.text: Activate 1 random 3-Cost Attack Card(s) in Draw Pile.

cards.name: Future Decreed IV
cards.text: Activate 2 random 2-Cost card(s) in hand.

cards.name: Future Decreed V
cards.text: When a card whose Cost is increased is used manually, 300% Damage to a random enemy.

cards.name: Chrono Circle
cards.text: Create 2 Fate Imprint.

cards.name: Chrono Circle I
cards.text: Create 3 Fate Imprint.

cards.name: Chrono Circle II
cards.text:
Create 2 Fate Imprint.
Retain: Create 1 Fate Imprint.

cards.name: Chrono Circle III
cards.text: When Chronal Ascension is gained, moves all Basic Cards of this unit to hand.

cards.name: Chrono Circle IV
cards.text: Select and Exhaust 1 Exhaust card(s) from all cards, then create Fate Imprint for each Cost of that card.

cards.name: Chrono Circle V
cards.text: When Chronal Ascension is gained, Draw 3 2-Cost Attack Card(s).

cards.name: Time Paradox
cards.text: Decrease all Chronicle. Gain Chronal Ascension for each decreased.

cards.name: Fate Imprint
cards.text:
120% Damage for each Cost of this card.
Increase Cost of all Fate Imprint in hand by 1.
When this card leaves the hand, change Cost to 2.

cards.name: Fate Distortion
cards.text:
Increase Damage Amount of the next Attack Card of this unit used by 30%.
Increase Damage Amount by an additional 10% for each Cost of that card.

potentials.name: Epiphany Bonus
potentials.text: When entering Chaos, obtain 1 random Rare Card with an activated Epiphany.

potentials.name: Basic Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Basic Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Common Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Common Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Basic Card Proficiency
potentials.text: +50% Damage Amount to the Time Acceleration card.

potentials.name: Unique Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Unique Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Basic Card Proficiency
potentials.text:
+5% Damage Amount to Rita's Time Acceleration.
If Rita's Attack is greater than 500, add an additional +5% to the modifier.

potentials.name: Divine Epiphany Adaptation
potentials.text: Increases the chance for a Divine Epiphany to appear by 25%.

potentials.name: Unique Stat Upgrade
potentials.text: If Rita's Attack is greater than 800, at the start of battle +10% Attack to herself.

manifestEgo.name: Sleeping Memory
manifestEgo.text: The Time Paradox card receives the following effect: If Chronicle is decreased by 6, gain 8 Chronal Ascension instead.

manifestEgo.name: Awakening Memory
manifestEgo.text:
When Chronal Ascension is gained, create 1 Fate Distortion.
Fate Distortion: Increase Damage Amount of the next Attack Card of this unit used by 30%.
Increase Damage Amount by an additional 10% for each Cost of that card.

manifestEgo.name: Vivid Memory
manifestEgo.text: Changes Hour of Glory's values to the following effect: increase Damage Amount of the next Attack Card of this unit used by 20% (max 300%).

manifestEgo.name: Inner Memory
manifestEgo.text:
When a 2-Cost or higher card is activated, gain 1 Trace of Memory.
Trace of Memory: increase Rita's Damage Amount by 5% for 1 turn (max 6 stacks)

manifestEgo.name: Complete Memory
manifestEgo.text: Increase the level of [Basic Card Upgrade], [Unique Card Upgrade], and [Common Card Upgrade] in Potentials by 3.

manifestEgo.name: Liberated Memory
manifestEgo.text:
When Chronal Ascension is gained, increase the value of Chronal Ascension gained by 6 (1 time per battle).
When Chronal Ascension is removed, inflict 80% Fixed Damage for each Chronal Ascension used over 1 turn.
